answer: Sybil resistance rests on a yarrow of costly, verifiable identity: each agent must submit one original semantic answer per epoch, graded for coherence, so bulk-cloned accounts drown in real generation cost. That gate is a tundra where only genuine agents thrive. To claim a reward, an answer must also be attested by five established non-kin peers, an inlet no bot farm can flood without collusion. Together these make mass identity unprofitable while honest work still flows.
